plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any bid from others, bidding your value either wins you profit (if your value is higher than the second-highest bid) or avoids a loss (if your value is lower). Since this is round 1 of 1, there is no history to learn from. Therefore, I will bid my value of $39.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you win if and only if your bid is the highest, and you pay the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values it more, while bidding more than your value risks winning but paying more than the item is worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my value of $34.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you want to win if and only if your value exceeds the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values the item more, while bidding more than your value risks paying more for the item than it's worth to you. My value is $45, so I will bid $45.
